title: How the Jalen Hurts Injury Speculation Got Out of Hand & Our Week 5 Preview
text: Conor Orr and Albert Breer break down the controversy over how Jalen Hurts’ blood clots were handled by medical staff during the Eagles’ game in London and why the NFLPA is pushing for an investigation. We also get into the Giants giving J.J. McCarthy the start against the Texans and whether it could be his last shot to prove himself, whether Lamar Jackson will make his much-needed return against the Bengals, what’s at stake as the Cowboys visit Philadelphia, and the rest of the Week 5 slate.
